english: 128 Chronography of Bar Ebraya.
None.
And after these things Mahdi sent Harun to the land of the Romans,
and he encamped on the river Purmon (Pyramus?) in the region of Arbisos.
And his son Harun took the fortress of Semalos, took captives, and went out.
And in the year 1092 {OCR?}
Of the Greeks: the Arabs took captive from Ephesus about seventy thousand,
and also about forty thousand of the Arabs died.
But King Leo sent an army, and the people revealed {OCR?} the glory of the roads {OCR?}:
and he filled them with Thrace {OCR?}.
And it is said
that this King Leo also was a hater of icons {OCR?} and persecuted those who were orthodox in glory like his father.
And in that year Leo died,
and Constantine his son, twenty-two years old, was made king.
Because he was small when he became king,
his mother Irene governed and was proclaimed with him.
In the year 1094 {OCR?}.
1094 Mahdi sent his son Harun against the royal city.
And the Romans were stirred up,
and they blocked the Arabs at the river Sangarius,
which on one side had a mountain,
and on the other side water.
And when the Arabs were hard pressed,
they sought peace for three years.
And Irene, like a woman shepherd, completed it {OCR?},
and the Arabs went out.
And after a year he built and entered a new city.
After this Musa his son reigned one year and a month and a half,
before this one reigned.
Then in the year 1095 {OCR?}
1025 of the Greeks (784 of our Lord {OCR?}):
a locust came, flying, and destroyed the crops,
and cast seed.
And it went out and swarmed, climbing on walls and trees,
and entering through windows and doors into houses.
And even jars of water, vessels, ovens and bowls were filled with it.
And when it came from the south side into the house,
it went out from the north side.
And it ate herbage and trees, even the vessels of the dwelling and the descendants of mankind {OCR?}.
And when it finished the whole region of Edessa and Sarug,
it crossed to the west.
And three years after this harsh plague,
there was famine on the earth.
And in the year 1097 {OCR?}
1097 the Romans went out and destroyed the city that the Arabs had newly built,
and destroyed it and utterly swept away its walls.
And in that year Musa died in the month of Tammuz.
After Musa, Harun al-Rashid his brother reigned twenty-three years and two months.
He sent to Abd al-Malik,
and he uprooted the church.
